findings: Included training adapts four AutoModelForSequenceClassification families using pseudo-labeled examples: ALBERT-xxlarge-v2, DeBERTa-large, RoBERTa-large, ELECTRA-large. MLM imports do not establish an executed masked-language-model adaptation stage.

No stochastic-weight-averaging implementation found in the pinned notebook code. Included model heads are library sequence-classification/regression heads; no custom attention-pooling implementation found.
Training tokenizes the entire provided text list with padding=True before dataset construction, not dynamic per-batch padding as asserted by intake.

Inference calls six configurations over six folds plus one full-data ALBERT and two additional DeBERTa bags:39 transformer states. Two ridge ensembles operate on model predictions, not transformer embeddings.
Final blend weights are3/8 first ridge ensemble,2/8 second ridge ensemble,3/8 special blend; special blend is65% single ALBERT plus35% mean of two DeBERTa predictions.

External examples selected using sentence-transformer semantic search and filtered by strict absolute pseudo-label difference below reference standard error. A separate linked Kaggle teacher notebook participates in the documented pipeline; source/license closure still needed.
Inference os.path.joun typo reproduced; second ridge ensemble trains five inputs but inference provides six, reproduced with synthetic fitted Ridge.

Additional static inconsistencies: repeated first DeBERTa in ridge training features versus second DeBERTa in inference; pretraining validation arrays reference training frame; some training call output variables differ from declared destinations; bootstrap comment versus ordinary fold directory.
